instrument_split: Every ceiling is SPLIT into (a) a FROZEN, design-neutral guarantee statement + derivation + kind + relativity note + lean obligation — no reference to any candidate design, B0 included — and (b) a NON-FROZEN attainment_witness_appendix that may cite B0 files. Only part (a) is the instrument; K-SUP and all closure constructions must be redefined as joins over the part-(a) guarantee profiles only.
honest_independence_statement: The v1 claim that the ceilings were definable before any candidate was examined is retracted as false: v1 attainment mechanisms were authored with B0 open on the desk and every ceiling carried a b0_gap field. The honest form, adopted here: the frozen guarantee statements and derivations are design-neutral and carry no candidate reference; the witness appendices use B0 as ONE constructive attainment witness, which biases mechanism choice but not the guarantee bound; the appendices are excluded from the frozen instrument and from any dominance or K-SUP construction.
witness_appendix_convention: attainment_witness_appendix sections are NON-FROZEN. Every claim of attainment, at-ceiling grade, or supreme grade is retyped as HYPOTHESIS: a candidate rank, UNKNOWN pending independently re-checkable verification artifacts (replay artifacts and discharged proof obligations). An assessor's unverifiable claim of a rank is not a rank. Empirical premises about external parties (publisher signing practice, network services) carry an evidence-status tag; VERIFIED_FROM_SECONDARY (search-excerpt or vendor/publisher-declared) material never grounds a rank — at most a KNOWN_UPPER_BOUND cap per the freeze v2. Resource facts (toolchain availability, witness enrollment, verified-compiler substrates) live in appendices or RESOURCE_BOUNDED clauses, never inside ABSOLUTE labels.
kind_taxonomy_note: ceiling_kind may be composite: clauses within one ceiling can carry different kinds (e.g. ABSOLUTE negative half / RESOURCE_BOUNDED positive clauses). An ABSOLUTE label may not lean on toolchain availability or cost; every such clause is carved out as RESOURCE_BOUNDED. Witness-quorum-conditioned caps are RESOURCE_BOUNDED throughout (witness networks are operational today), matching the labeling standard AX-21 already used in v1.
